name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
how_to:
1. Setup:
  - Attach the rope attachment to the pulley of the cable machine.
  - Stand facing away from the machine and grab the rope with both hands using a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
  - Step forward slightly to create tension in the cable and position your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Starting Position:
  - Raise your arms overhead, keeping your elbows bent and pointing forward.
  - Your hands should be behind your head, and your core should be engaged to maintain stability.
3. Execution:
  - Extend your arms fully by pushing the rope upward and forward until your elbows are straight.
  - Squeeze your triceps at the top of the movement for maximum contraction.
  - Slowly lower the rope back to the starting position, controlling the movement to maintain tension.
4. Repetitions and Breathing:
  - Perform 10-15 repetitions per set, depending on your training goals.
  - Inhale while lowering the rope and exhale as you extend your arms.
